    (z : ℂ) (J : D4ComplexRadialThreeJet) : D4ComplexRadialTwoJet :=
  let S := d4KIScalarZtildeThreeJetOfBMMaster z J
  let V := d4KIVectorRhoFtThreeJetOfBMMaster z J
  { value := (1 - z) * S.value - V.value
    first := -S.value + (1 - z) * S.first - V.first
    second := -2 * S.first + (1 - z) * S.second - V.second }

two derivatives exactly. -/
theorem d4KIScalarVectorChiralCarrierTwoJetOfBMThreeJet_eq_masterTwoJet
    (z : ℂ) (J : D4ComplexRadialThreeJet) :
    d4KIScalarVectorChiralCarrierTwoJetOfBMThreeJet z J = J.toTwoJet := by
  rcases J with ⟨value, first, second, third⟩
  simp only [d4KIScalarVectorChiralCarrierTwoJetOfBMThreeJet,
    d4KIScalarZtildeThreeJetOfBMMaster,
    d4KIVectorRhoFtThreeJetOfBMMaster,
    D4ComplexRadialThreeJet.toTwoJet]

    (rho sigmaInv : ℂ) (J : D4ComplexRadialThreeJet) :
    d4PoincareRadialTwoJetOfBMInv rho sigmaInv
        (d4KIScalarVectorChiralCarrierTwoJetOfBMThreeJet (1 - rho ^ 2) J) =
      d4PoincareRadialTwoJetOfBMInv rho sigmaInv J.toTwoJet := by
  rw [d4KIScalarVectorChiralCarrierTwoJetOfBMThreeJet_eq_masterTwoJet]

/-- Consequently the full deformed two-leg AdS self-dual vertex is unchanged when each BM master
two-jet is supplied through its independently reconstructed scalar--vector KI metric carrier. -/
theorem ads4SelfDualDeformedVertexOnKIScalarVectorChiralTwoJets_eq_master
    (rho sigmaInv xBracket q1 q2 q1w q2w : ℂ)
    (P Q : D4ComplexRadialThreeJet) :

        (d4PoincareRadialTwoJetOfBMInv rho sigmaInv

        (d4PoincareRadialTwoJetOfBMInv rho sigmaInv

  rw [d4KIScalarVectorChiralCarrierTwoJetOfBMThreeJet_eq_masterTwoJet,

/-!
# The collision support lies over a single point

`(D-f)` says any two collisions of the Schur reduction have the same reduced state, so the whole
collision support sits inside one fibre of the reduction.  Consequently the collision bound that
the transposition criterion consumes reduces to a single count: how many sheets lie over that one
point.
-/

namespace GaloisForLFunctions.HTGeometry

noncomputable section

open Polynomial IsLocalRing

set_option maxHeartbeats 4000000
set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 1000000

variable (K : Type*) [Field K] [CharZero K] [IsAlgClosed K] {m n : ℕ}
variable [Fact (0 < m)] [Fact (0 < n)] [Fact (1 < m)] [Fact (1 < n)]

/-- **The whole collision support of the Schur reduction sits over one point.** -/
theorem criticalSchur_collisionSupport_reducedFibre_eq [DecidableEq K]
    {σ τ : criticalGeometricSheet K m n}
    (hσ : σ ∈ collisionSupport
      (criticalGeometricSheetToSchurReducedFibre K (Fact.out : 1 < m) (Fact.out : 1 < n)))
    (hτ : τ ∈ collisionSupport
      (criticalGeometricSheetToSchurReducedFibre K (Fact.out : 1 < m) (Fact.out : 1 < n))) :
    criticalGeometricSheetToSchurReducedFibre K (Fact.out : 1 < m) (Fact.out : 1 < n) σ
      = criticalGeometricSheetToSchurReducedFibre K (Fact.out : 1 < m) (Fact.out : 1 < n) τ := by
  obtain ⟨y, hyne, hy⟩ := hσ
  obtain ⟨z, hzne, hz⟩ := hτ
  exact criticalSchur_reducedFibre_eq_of_collisions K σ y τ z (Ne.symm hyne) hy.symm
    (Ne.symm hzne) hz.symm

/-- **`(D)` modulo the fibre count.**  If the reduction is at most two-to-one over the single
collision point, the collision support has at most two elements. -/
theorem criticalSchur_collisionSupport_ncard_le_two_of_fibre [DecidableEq K]
    [Finite (criticalGeometricSheet K m n)]
    (hfib : ∀ σ : criticalGeometricSheet K m n,
      ({τ | criticalGeometricSheetToSchurReducedFibre K (Fact.out : 1 < m) (Fact.out : 1 < n) τ
        = criticalGeometricSheetToSchurReducedFibre K (Fact.out : 1 < m)
          (Fact.out : 1 < n) σ}).ncard ≤ 2) :
    (collisionSupport
      (criticalGeometricSheetToSchurReducedFibre K (Fact.out : 1 < m)
        (Fact.out : 1 < n))).ncard ≤ 2 := by
  classical
  by_cases hempty : collisionSupport
      (criticalGeometricSheetToSchurReducedFibre K (Fact.out : 1 < m)
        (Fact.out : 1 < n)) = ∅
  · rw [hempty]
    simp
  · obtain ⟨σ₀, hσ₀⟩ := Set.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mpr hempty
    refine le_trans (Set.ncard_le_ncard ?_ ?_) (hfib σ₀)
    · intro τ hτ
      exact criticalSchur_collisionSupport_reducedFibre_eq K hτ hσ₀
    · exact Set.Finite.subset (Set.finite_univ) (Set.subset_univ _)

end

/-!
# Conditional bookkeeping for an extended-natural count

Every declaration below concerns an arbitrary `M : ℝ → ℕ∞`. Monotonicity is supplied as `hsturm`,
and the finite-count branch is supplied as `hcollide`. The dichotomy combines those assumptions;
it does not prove them for a zero count. Likewise, `transition_at_zero` takes both one-sided
conclusions as premises, and `criterion_vacuous` assumes infinitude at negative times.

This module defines neither the de Bruijn–Newman flow nor its non-real zero count. It supplies no
Sturm persistence theorem, small-gap collision estimate, or Ki–Kim–Lee theorem for that flow.
Its declarations therefore do not establish an unconditional finiteness transition or retire a
negative-time falsification route. The historical name `count_zero_of_rh` also uses only the
abstract assumption `M 0 = 0`, not the proposition `RiemannHypothesis`.
-/

open Set

noncomputable section

namespace RHTower

/-- Specialize assumed antitonicity of an arbitrary count to times `t ≤ 0`. -/
theorem nonreal_count_mono {M : ℝ → ℕ∞} (hsturm : ∀ ⦃s t : ℝ⦄, s ≤ t → M t ≤ M s)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : t ≤ 0) : M 0 ≤ M t := hsturm ht

/-- An antitone extended-natural count infinite at zero is infinite at every nonpositive time. -/
theorem caseA {M : ℝ → ℕ∞} (hsturm : ∀ ⦃s t : ℝ⦄, s ≤ t → M t ≤ M s)
    (h0 : M 0 = ⊤) {t : ℝ} (ht : t ≤ 0) : M t = ⊤ :=
  top_unique (h0 ▸ nonreal_count_mono hsturm ht)

/-- Apply the assumed finite-count implication; no collision estimate is proved here. -/
theorem caseB {M : ℝ → ℕ∞} {t : ℝ}
    (hcollide : M 0 ≠ ⊤ → M t = ⊤) (h0 : M 0 ≠ ⊤) : M t = ⊤ := hcollide h0

/-- Combine assumed antitonicity and the assumed finite-count implication by a dichotomy at zero. -/
theorem infinite_of_neg {M : ℝ → ℕ∞} (hsturm : ∀ ⦃s t : ℝ⦄, s ≤ t → M t ≤ M s)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : t < 0) (hcollide : M 0 ≠ ⊤ → M t = ⊤) : M t = ⊤ := by
  by_cases h0 : M 0 = ⊤
  · exact caseA hsturm h0 (le_of_lt ht)
  · exact hcollide h0

/-- Package two assumed one-sided count statements at a given time. -/
theorem transition_at_zero {M : ℝ → ℕ∞}
    (hpos : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → M t ≠ ⊤) (hneg : ∀ t : ℝ, t < 0 → M t = ⊤)
    (t : ℝ) : (0 < t → M t ≠ ⊤) ∧ (t < 0 → M t = ⊤) :=
  ⟨hpos t, hneg t⟩

/-- Assumed infinitude at every negative time contradicts finiteness at one such time. -/
theorem criterion_vacuous {M : ℝ → ℕ∞} (hneg : ∀ t : ℝ, t < 0 → M t = ⊤)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : t < 0) (hfin : M t ≠ ⊤) : False := hfin (hneg t ht)

/-- An arbitrary extended-natural count equal to zero at time zero is not infinite there. -/
theorem count_zero_of_rh {M : ℝ → ℕ∞} (hRH : M 0 = 0) : M 0 ≠ ⊤ := by
  rw [hRH]; exact fun h => by simp at h

end RHTower

/-
# The signature-collision mechanism: an off-line zero is a resolved Krein collision

The seam Krein index counts off-line zeros (`SeamInertiaCharge`), but a count is not a mechanism.
Krein–Gelfand–Lidskii stability theory supplies the missing "how": in a Hamiltonian/Krein setting an
eigenvalue leaves the real axis *only* through a collision of two modes of **opposite Krein
signature**, at which the form degenerates.  This file transposes that mechanism to the functional
equation of `ξ`, and finds it algebraically exact.

The FE conjugate pair `{t, t̄}` builds two carrier vectors on nodes `z`:
`w = e + a` (`a_j = (t−z_j)⁻¹`, `e_j = (t̄−z_j)⁻¹`) and `u = e − a`.  In the factored seam Krein form
`Σ w w* − Σ u u*`, `w` carries the positive square and `u` carries the negative square.  The **order
parameter of the collision is `u`**:

* `seamU_eq_zero_iff_online` — `u = 0` **iff** the pair is on the critical line (`Im t = 0`, where
  `t = t̄` so `e = a`).  The negative carrier vanishes exactly at the collision point.
* `kreinNonneg_of_online` — on the line (`u = 0`) the seam form is `Σ w w*`, positive semidefinite: a
  **definite** form whose positive polarization is *explicitly* the `w` carriers.  Collision
  unresolved ⟹ no negative direction.
* `offLine_opposite_signature` — off the line the carrier is indefinite: it has a strictly positive
  Krein direction *and* a strictly negative one (`conj_pair_carrier_indefinite`).  The two modes of
  opposite signature have separated — the collision has **resolved** into an off-line zero.
* `collision_at_critical_line` — through `t = (ρ−½)·(−i)`, the order parameter vanishes iff `Re ρ = ½`.
  RH is the statement that every FE pair sits exactly at its collision point on the critical line.

So the birth of the negative Krein mode is not a bookkeeping increment but the resolution of a
signature collision: `u` grows from `0` precisely as the pair leaves the line.  The critical line is
the collision locus of the FE-forced Krein form.
-/
import GaloisForLFunctions.RHTower.SeamInertiaCharge
import GaloisForLFunctions.HTGeometry.CarrierPickKernel

open Complex Matrix GaloisForLFunctions
open scoped BigOperators ComplexOrder

namespace RHTower

noncomputable section

/-! ### The collision order parameter -/

/-- **The negative carrier vanishes exactly on the line, node by node.**  `seamU t z i j = 0` iff
`t̄ᵢ = tᵢ`, i.e. `Im tᵢ = 0`: at the collision the two poles `t, t̄` coincide so `e = a` and `u = e−a`
vanishes.  Unconditional (`inv_inj` needs no node-avoidance hypothesis). -/
theorem seamU_apply_eq_zero_iff {k N : ℕ} (t : Fin k → ℂ) (z : Fin N → ℂ) (i : Fin k) (j : Fin N) :
    seamU t z i j = 0 ↔ (t i).im = 0 := by
  unfold seamU
  rw [sub_eq_zero, _root_.inv_inj, sub_left_inj,
    show star (t i) = (starRingEnd ℂ) (t i) from rfl, Complex.conj_eq_iff_im]

/-- **The collision order parameter.**  The negative Krein carrier `u_i = e_i − a_i` of the FE pair
vanishes as a whole vector **iff** the pair is on the critical line (`Im tᵢ = 0`).  Off the line it is
nonzero — the negative mode is present. -/
theorem seamU_eq_zero_iff_online {k N : ℕ} [Nonempty (Fin N)] (t : Fin k → ℂ) (z : Fin N → ℂ)
    (i : Fin k) : seamU t z i = 0 ↔ (t i).im = 0 := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨j⟩ := (inferInstance : Nonempty (Fin N))
    exact (seamU_apply_eq_zero_iff t z i j).mp (congrFun h j)
  · intro h; funext j; exact (seamU_apply_eq_zero_iff t z i j).mpr h

/-! ### Collision unresolved (on the line) ⟹ definite, with explicit polarization -/

/-- A positive-semidefinite Hermitian Gram has no negative Krein direction. -/
theorem kreinNonneg_of_posSemidef {N : ℕ} {H : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ} (hH : H.PosSemidef) :
    KreinNonneg H := by
  intro x
  have h := hH.dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg x
  rw [Complex.le_def] at h
  simpa using h.1

/-- With the negative carrier absent (`u = 0`) the factored Krein form is the sum of positive
outer products `Σ w w*`, hence positive semidefinite: the positive polarization is the `w` carriers. -/
theorem factoredKrein_zero_u_posSemidef {N k : ℕ} (w : Fin k → (Fin N → ℂ)) :
    (factoredKreinForm w (0 : Fin k → (Fin N → ℂ))).PosSemidef := by
  have hzero : (∑ i, Matrix.of (fun p q => (0 : Fin k → (Fin N → ℂ)) i p *
      star ((0 : Fin k → (Fin N → ℂ)) i q))) = 0 := by
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun i _ => ?_); ext p q; simp
  rw [factoredKreinForm, hzero, sub_zero]
  exact Matrix.posSemidef_sum Finset.univ (fun i _ => outer_posSemidef _)

/-- **Collision unresolved ⟹ definite (explicit polarization).**  If every FE pair sits on the
critical line (`Im tᵢ = 0` for all `i`), the seam Krein form has no negative direction
